summary: This component renders a blog post item by assembling several sub-components (header, content, footer) inside a container. It uses a custom hook to determine whether extra bottom spacing should be added, which depends on whether we're viewing a single post page or a list of posts.

explanations.3: This hook fetches blog post context from Docusaurus, which tells us whether the current view is a full blog post page or just a preview in a list.
explanations.10: The useBlogPost hook gives us an object with an isBlogPostPage flag that tells us what kind of view we're in.
explanations.11: If we're NOT on the full blog post page (meaning we're in a list view), we add bottom margin spacing; otherwise we return undefined so no extra margin is applied.
explanations.13: This component accepts children (the main content) and className (any extra CSS classes the parent might want to apply).
explanations.16: clsx is a utility that combines multiple CSS class names together, filtering out any undefined or false values, so we get a clean final className string.
